intervals: start inclusive, end exclusive; America/New_York wall-clock labels
target: retrospectively cleaned recorded pickups per zone per hour
rules: Select hyperparameters and history length using 2024 validation only.
The 2025 holdout may be checked for schema and data quality, not model selection.
Only model_eligible rows may be targets; fit all learned transforms on training rows.
Features must use hours earlier than the target hour; never include target-hour quality flags.
Never forward-fill masked DST or missing-source labels. Lag/window features depending on missing labels are unavailable.
Evaluation is retrospective one-step forecasting, not proof of real-time source availability.
